body.zh: H⁺ 与 OH⁻ 按 1:1 结合成水并放热（教学近似约 57 kJ/mol）。滴定时加入的碱先被酸“吃掉”，pH 缓慢爬升；接近等量点时少量碱就能让 pH 大幅跳动，这就是终点的由来。
body.en: H⁺ and OH⁻ combine 1:1 into water, releasing heat (≈57 kJ/mol teaching approximation). During titration added base is consumed and pH climbs slowly; near the equivalence point a small addition swings pH sharply — that is the endpoint.

misconception.zh: 中和不是把酸“盖住”，而是 H⁺ 真的被消耗掉了。
misconception.en: Neutralization is not covering the acid up — H⁺ is actually consumed.
